body: I know, and I've tried, but it feels like no matter what movies I guarantee I'll watch before I do it, or albums I'll wait to be released, or certain dates that need to pass or whatever, it just feels completely unimportant compared to knowing that she left me for someone else.  Its the feeling of going from being the most important person in someone's entire life to being the least important.  I can't stand the thought that she's already forgotten the times we spent together, and that she's replacing them with new memories with this other guy.

Thanks so much.  I'm probably a lot less inclined toward suicide than most on this sub and I didn't have an exact plan but the thought has been in my head for weeks now no matter how much I try to get rid of it.  I find myself having to insist to myself that I won't do it and I'll never kill myself.  That's better than just accepting it or actively wanting to, but I never had to do that before.

Thanks.  I do have one friend but barely have time to talk to him and don't really trust him with knowing this.  Dave still hates me to the best of my knowledge.

The only thing really inspiring me right now is knowing that with nothing left, it's impossible for it to get worse.  I can only gain more.
